name: HereSphere
description: Exposes the Cove library to HereSphere v1 clients: catalog, per-video metadata, media streaming, Cove-matched thumbnails and previews, Cove-driven auth, per-user rating/favorite write-back, categorized tags (tags, groups, performers, studios, resolution tiers) in a configurable order, Cove segments as timeline markers, sidecar subtitles, static/dynamic group library sections, and a settings page with API token revocation.
author: abla7e
